shield.almost.subtitle.es: A unos %2$lld min caminando de ganar tus próximos %1$lld min.

shield.available.subtitle.en: Choose a session. The rest stays yours.
shield.available.subtitle.es: Elige una sesión. El resto sigue siendo tuyo.

shield.expired.subtitle.en: Walk toward %lld steps to earn more. Your apps are paused for now.
shield.expired.subtitle.es: Camina hasta %lld pasos para ganar más. Tus apps están en pausa.

shield.updating.subtitle.es: Abre Earnit para actualizar tu progreso.

NSHealthShareUsageDescription.en: Earnit reads your daily step count so walking can earn screen time. Your health data stays on this device.
NSHealthShareUsageDescription.es: Earnit lee tu recuento diario de pasos para convertir tus caminatas en tiempo de pantalla. Tus datos de salud permanecen en este dispositivo.

NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription.en: Earnit may update Health data to keep your activity-related progress synchronized with your earned screen time.

NSCameraUsageDescription.en: Earnit uses the camera to read study material or count exercise repetitions live on your device. Images and video are not saved.

NSUserTrackingUsageDescription.en: Your permission allows us to link app activity with advertising data to measure campaign results and improve future ads.
NSUserTrackingUsageDescription.es: Tu permiso nos permite vincular la actividad de la app con datos publicitarios para medir los resultados de las campañas y mejorar futuros anuncios.
